title: Financial Statement Spreading
summary: Read audited financials, notes and schedules in Schedule III, Ind AS or IFRS layouts and map every line into your spreading template or CMA format, each figure traced to its page.

seo.title: AI Financial Statement Spreading | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that extracts balance sheets, P&L and notes from annual reports, maps them to your spread or CMA format and checks every total ties.

designed_for: CMA and Project Finance Team Lead

problem.intro: Advisory, valuation and project-finance teams spend hours copying balance sheets, profit and loss statements and notes from annual reports into a standard model before any analysis starts. Every company groups items differently, the real detail sits in the notes, and a typo in a re-keyed figure can travel through ratios, CMA data and valuation outputs unnoticed.

pain_points.title: No two annual reports look alike
pain_points.detail: Schedule III, Ind AS and IFRS layouts, standalone and consolidated sets, and scanned older years all need different handling.

pain_points.title: Mapping needs the notes
pain_points.detail: Other current liabilities may hide statutory dues, capital creditors and advances, and the right template line depends on the note breakdown.

pain_points.title: Re-keying errors spread
pain_points.detail: A transposed figure breaks the balance check or, worse, balances by coincidence and flows into every downstream ratio.

pain_points.title: Multi-year comparisons drift
pain_points.detail: Restated comparatives and reclassifications between years are easy to miss when each year is keyed separately.

solution.overview: We build a spreading assistant that takes annual reports, audited financial statements or MCA-filed financials and maps them into your firm's template: a standard spread, a CMA data format for working capital proposals, or a due diligence databook. It finds the primary statements and notes, extracts every line with its note reference, and proposes a mapping to your template lines based on the note detail rather than the caption alone. Arithmetic checks confirm that subtotals, totals and the balance sheet hold, and that comparatives agree with last year's spread. Lines with low mapping confidence or failed checks are queued for an analyst before ratios are calculated.
capabilities: Locates the balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow and notes in long annual reports, including scanned years
Extracts line items with note references across standalone, consolidated, current and comparative columns
Proposes template mappings from note breakdowns and remembers analyst corrections for each client
Tie-out checks on subtotals, balance sheet balance, cash flow and comparatives against the prior spread
Flags restatements, reclassifications and auditor qualifications or emphasis-of-matter paragraphs
Exports to your Excel model, a CMA format or your credit or valuation template

workflow.title: Upload the financial statements
workflow.detail: Annual reports, audited statements or XBRL filings for the years in scope are added to the engagement.

workflow.title: Locate statements and notes
workflow.detail: Pages are classified so that the primary statements and each note are found, whatever the report's layout.

workflow.title: Extract line items
workflow.detail: Figures are extracted with captions, note references and column context, each linked to its page.

workflow.title: Map to the template
workflow.detail: Each line is mapped to your spreading template using the note breakdown and earlier corrections.

workflow.title: Check and confirm
workflow.detail: Tie-out failures and low-confidence mappings go to an analyst, who confirms or corrects them.

workflow.title: Calculate and export
workflow.detail: Ratios are calculated and the spread is exported with a page-level trace for every figure.

inputs: Annual reports or audited financial statements (PDF)
XBRL financial statements filed with MCA, where available
Prior-year spreads for the same company
Your spreading template or CMA format
outputs: Mapping table with note references and source pages
Flags for qualifications, restatements and reclassifications
human_in_the_loop: Analysts confirm every mapping below the confidence threshold and every failed tie-out before ratios are calculated. Interpretation of the numbers, including any credit view, valuation assumption or projection, stays with the advisory team.

guardrails: Every figure traced to its page and note
Balance sheet must balance before export

compliance_notes: Financial statements of unlisted clients are confidential; processing stays in your environment with access limited to the engagement team.
A spread supports analysis; it is not an audit or assurance opinion on the underlying statements.

faqs.q: Does it work on older, scanned annual reports?
faqs.a: Yes, with OCR and layout detection. Scanned pages produce more low-confidence values, which go to the analyst, and the pilot reports accuracy separately for digital and scanned statements.

faqs.q: Can it use our own spreading template or a bank's CMA format?
faqs.a: Yes. Your template is the target. We set up the mapping to your line items, and analyst corrections are remembered for that client and template.

faqs.q: Will it generate projections or a credit view?
faqs.a: No. It produces the historical spread, tie-out checks and ratios. Projections, assumptions and any credit or valuation conclusion remain your team's work.

faqs.q: Does it handle Ind AS, IFRS and consolidated statements?
faqs.a: Yes. It distinguishes standalone from consolidated statements and current from comparative columns, and it flags restated comparatives so they are not mixed with previously reported figures.
